summary: Iter 32 — Focused retest of iter31's two CRITICAL Phase 1b bugs. All 9 targeted tests PASS. Both fixes verified: (1) GET /api/admin/presales/leads now returns 200 for legacy tz-aware `created_at` rows (verified against seeded row with '2026-01-01T00:00:00+00:00' AND live DB with 18 pre-existing rows — endpoint returns 200 with populated items[]/stats{} and correct sla_breached booleans). (2) PATCH /api/admin/presales/leads/{id}/status with status=consult_done now (a) correctly flips ONLY the linked user's free_consult_used=True when user_id is present, and (b) does NOT mutate any user document when user_id is missing/None — a distinctive-email canary user AND the earliest-created other user in the collection both remain pristine (free_consult_used=False, free_consult_available=True) after both the missing-user_id and null-user_id PATCH paths. Status history appends (grows by 1 per call, not replaced). Documents regression (/documents/upload → /documents/mine → /admin/documents/pending → /admin/documents/{id}/review reupload) all pass. Server.py:6522-6606 review confirms the fixes: line 6534 `now = datetime.now(timezone.utc)`, lines 6541-6544 normalize `created` to tz-aware, line 6578 projection includes `user_id: 1`, and lines 6595-6600 guard `if linked_user_id` before calling users.update_one. No new issues found.

critical_code_review_comments: Bug #1 fix (server.py:6534,6541-6546) is clean — uses `datetime.now(timezone.utc)` for `now` and coerces any tz-naive `created` back to UTC-aware via `.replace(tzinfo=timezone.utc)`. Handles both 'Z' and '+00:00' variants and legacy naive strings.

Bug #2 fix (server.py:6578,6595-6600) correctly (a) adds `user_id: 1` to the projection and (b) wraps the users.update_one call in `if linked_user_id:` — no more empty-filter side-effect. The lead's own `free_consult_available=False` still lands regardless, which is intended.
Note (still outstanding from iter31 minor list, unrelated to these bugs): LeadStatusIn.status uses a hardcoded Literal[...] that duplicates LEAD_STATUSES — cosmetic drift risk only.
